posts.title: A workaround for "framework 'AGL' not found" for Qt on macOS
posts.description: Non-commercial prebuilt Qt versions below 6.9 currently fail to link on macOS Tahoe (macOS 26). Two quick specific examples are Qt 6.5.3 and 6.8.3, both offered in the maintenance tool at the time of writing.
